_about: Corrections to the upstream N3 word list, applied by build_content.py. Keys are 'expression|reading' exactly as they appear in oajd_n3.csv. Each entry may replace the expression, the reading or the meaning, and says why.

下す|おろす.why: おろす (to lower) is written 下ろす. 下す is くだす, to hand down a decision.

反る|かえる.why: To warp or curve is そる. かえる is a different verb, to turn over.

盛り|さかり.why: The listed meaning, a serving of food, belongs to the reading もり.

無|ぶ.why: ぶ only occurs as a prefix, as in 無事 or 無沙汰. Nothing or zero is む.

下|しも.why: The upstream list gives every reading of 下 the same gloss.

下|げ.meaning: low grade, inferior, last volume (of a set)
下|げ.why: The upstream list gives every reading of 下 the same gloss.

上|かみ.why: The listed meaning, first volume or superior quality, belongs to じょう.

対|たい.meaning: versus, against, to (in a score or ratio)
対|たい.why: A pair or set is つい, which has its own card.

金|かね.why: Gold is きん, which has its own card.

金|きん.why: Money is かね, which has its own card.

分|ぶ.meaning: advantage, odds, one tenth, one percent
分|ぶ.why: A part or share is ぶん, which has its own card.

退く|どく.meaning: to step aside, to move out of the way, to make way
退く|どく.why: To retreat or withdraw is the reading しりぞく or ひく.

否|いや.why: 'The noes' in a vote is the reading ひ.

末|すえ.meaning: the end, the tip, the future
末|すえ.why: Powder is the reading まつ, as in 粉末.

末|まつ.meaning: the end of (a month, a year), powder
末|まつ.why: Moved 'powder' here from すえ, where it does not apply.

節|せつ.why: The listed 'when, if' is a loose rendering of 'on the occasion of'.
